class.name: AudioStreamFluidSynth
class.brief_description: AudioStream that renders through the FluidSynth singleton.
class.description: AudioStreamFluidSynth is a thin shim around the [FluidSynth] singleton. Its [method _instantiate_playback] returns an [AudioStreamPlaybackFluidSynth] and its [method gen_tone] delegates to [method FluidSynth.gen_tone]. SoundFont and MIDI resources are stored as [SoundFontFileReader] and [MidiFileReader] and forwarded to the singleton on set.

method.name: set_soundfont
method.description: Stores [param soundfont] and forwards its path to [method FluidSynth.set_soundfont] when the singleton exists.

method.name: set_midi_file
method.description: Stores [param midi_file] and forwards it to [method FluidSynth.set_midi_file] when the singleton exists.
